duration.text: The Accounting at Xi'an International University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5000 USD/per year ￥ 36000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Scanned PDF copy of passport homepage (valid for more than 6 months)Original copies of high school courses, transcripts, and notarized documents from the Chinese EmbassyOriginal high school graduation certificate and notarized document from the Chinese Embassy.Original College Transcript (in English)Scanned PDF copy of HSK transcript (HSK4 and above certificate)8 photos (white background, passport size, taken within 3 months)Electronic ID photo (JPG format, within 1M, white background, taken within 3 months)Certificate of no criminal record and Chinese translation (within 6 months) Medical examination certificate (within 6 months)

requirements.text: Age: between 18-50 years old;Non Chinese citizens with a high school diploma or above and holding a valid foreign passport.Can afford to study and live expenses in ChinaScore: GPA 2.5 or above (4.5 benchmark)Language:-Teaching in Chinese: Hold HSK Level 4 or above certificate-English taught: IELTS 5, TOEFL iBT 60, TOEIC 450
